name: CuckTales 2 🐓
source:
A Broken RV, A Disastrous Road Trip:
Can You Survive the Ultimate Test of Your Dignity?

The story follows a broke college student who wins a "luxury RV road trip" in a contest he barely remembers entering. Armed with naive optimism, he invites his hot girlfriend Stacy and her three friends—Raven, Chloe, and Luna—expecting a romantic summer getaway filled with adventure and passion.

Reality hits hard when the "luxury RV" turns out to be a rusted bucket of bolts, the "scenic route" becomes a tour of the country's weirdest dive bars and roadside attractions, and our protagonist finds himself constantly outmaneuvered by comically alpha locals and his own crippling insecurities.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4134900/]Steam[/url]]
